skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding basic concepts of corporate finance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand fundamental concepts related to corporate finance.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Comparing different types of business entities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to compare various types of business entities.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing basic issues in corporate finance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to analyze common issues in corporate finance.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding principles of corporate financial management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the principles of managing corporate finances.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding objectives of corporate financial management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the goals of corporate financial management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding structure and characteristics of financial reports
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the structure and characteristics of financial reports.
Students will be able to create financial reports for businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding impact of various taxes on businesses
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand how different types of taxes affect businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding general concept of time value of money
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the concept of time value of money.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Calculating future value of single sum of money
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to calculate the future value of a single sum of money.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Calculating present value of single sum of money
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to calculate the present value of a single sum of money.
Students will understand the principles of asset valuation.
Students will be able to value bonds.
Students will be able to value preferred stocks.
Students will be able to value common stocks.
Students will understand the sources of business capital.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing methods of raising debt capital
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to analyze methods of raising debt capital.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing methods of raising equity capital
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to analyze methods of raising equity capital.

Students will be able to work independently and collaboratively in choosing topics and organizing solutions to problems in the field of finance and banking with social responsibility and professional ethics.
